tests/test.sh:162-210 (unchanged from frozen template) sends TERM to old group, waits only 5 seconds, starts a new process, then treats any HTTPError as ready; it never verifies old group gone or new PID alive.
quality.counterexample: A SIGTERM-resistant old server can keep port 3000 while the replacement exits EADDRINUSE. The helper still reports success from the old listener, so hro_restart can credit persistence without a restart; final cleanup can also wait indefinitely on the old group.
quality.suggested_fix: In the shared template harness, terminate and verify the old group, check new PID liveness and expected listener identity, reject HTTP errors, and bound final cleanup.

instruction.md:9 mandates Express, SQLite and an app that does not use an external backend; tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:15 explicitly says browser evidence cannot infer SQLite, and all prompts prohibit source inspection.
quality.counterexample: A Node app using an in-memory JS object or external data service could expose the same browser responses and earn the entire rubric while violating mandatory SQLite/local-data requirements.
quality.suggested_fix: Remove technology mandates that the browser judge cannot verify, or add an authorized observable artifact/proof channel consistent with the template policy.
